name: yolov8n_backbone
_source: Ultralytics YOLOv8n backbone (yolov8.yaml, scale 'n': depth=0.33, width=0.25) - layer channel counts taken from an actual torch model summary printout (Conv/C2f/SPPF args), cross-checked against docs.ultralytics.com/guides/model-yaml-config and github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics issue #189/#13207.
_scope: Backbone only (layers 0-9: stem convs + C2f stages + SPPF). The neck (FPN/PAN upsample+concat+C2f) and Detect head are NOT included: they consume multiple earlier feature maps via skip-connection concat, which this script's linear (single current-shape) Expander does not support. Extending Expander to a small DAG (tracking named intermediate tensors, e.g. after layer 4 and layer 6, and a 'concat' op) is the natural next step if you need the full network - the backbone already exercises the interesting NPU behavior (dense conv, C2f's mix of 1x1/3x3 dense convs) since YOLOv8 does NOT use depthwise convs at all (unlike MobileNet).
_notes: YOLOv8 uses regular (dense) convolutions throughout - no depthwise layers - so this model is a good contrast case against mobilenetv2.json: expect NPU utilization to track the tile-padding math (M,N vs pe_rows/pe_cols) much more cleanly, without the depthwise call-overhead effects MobileNet shows.
SPPF's three 5x5 maxpools are not modeled on the NPU (see model_to_npu_calls.py docstring).
